$comment: DRAFT — not generated, not approved, not wired into any runtime path. Target shape follows Fable5PrefabSpec.md section 7 and matches the char_player entry already present in tools/asset-forge/contracts/asset-contract.sample.json (png/pivot/sheet fields are intentionally identical to that sample). This file adds draftMeta for traceability only; draftMeta is not part of the Fable5PrefabSpec section 7 field set and a future normalize-check.mjs lint should ignore it or this file should be stripped down to the core fields before promotion.

draftMeta.purpose: New-generation Fable5 player contract. It is a draft only and is not an approval, promotion, export, or runtime authorization.

identitySource.role: sole player identity and character-style authority
identitySource.derivationRule: char_player must be a direct visual derivation of this exact source: preserve the same individual, visible identity, proportions, silhouette, pixel density, contour language, and shading language. Only the required four camera directions and idle/walk/interact phases may be invented.

draftMeta.historicalCandidatePolicy: All earlier character candidates, generated sheets, and deployed character art are prohibited as visual references, derivation inputs, comparison authorities, or runtime-promotion sources. They may remain quarantined as historical records only.

backgroundShadingReference.useAs: lighting/shading-density match only (twilight upper-left light, 2-3 shading steps, ambient palette) — not a crop or composition source for the character sheet itself
backgroundShadingReference.verifiedIndependently: sha256 recomputed 2026-07-21 from both public/fable5-v2/assets/world/target-town-user-direct-v1.png and art/references/user-provided/target-town.png, byte-identical, matches public/fable5-v2/assets/world/target-town-user-direct-v1.lineage.json

draftMeta.prefabSpecAuthority: Fable5PrefabSpec.md section 6 (canvas 64x128, footPivot 32,120 fixed, 640x512 sheet, idle2/walk6/interact2, east not a mirror of west) and section 7 (this JSON's field set)
generationRoute: make-fable5-character-job --asset char_player (portable job-pack only; no image produced)
external human-supervised generation from the exact sole identity/style authority
Fable5-specific pending intake and mechanical validation
human-only review and a separate approval decision before any runtime installation
draftMeta.notGeneratedReason: Task scope excludes real image generation and approval; this contract only commits the source authority and fixed sheet requirements for a future supervised session.
